input.answer: If I had to pick from this page, I'd go with Harel (הראל), a name I know, and its "כספי (שקלי)" track (קופה 13254). It shows 0% for מניות and 0% for מט"ח, 4.25% a year over 3 years, and a fee of 0.57% "מההחיסכון". But I wouldn't sign anything before you or the bank explain what "כספי" is and whether it's as safe as my פיקדון.

stuck.why: The page opens with a big table of 'מסלולים' and buttons like 'עוקב מדד S&P 500' with English letters. Nothing about deposits or safe saving, so I nearly left. I only stayed because I came to open a קופת גמל להשקעה, and that button was already lit up.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the row of buttons under 'במה הכסף מושקע'
stuck.why: I saw 'אג"ח ממשלתי 3' and 'אג"ח ממשלתי סחיר 1', which I know are safe. But the table underneath didn't show them, and I didn't know whether pressing the button would change the list.
The little circles mean nothing to me. Some rows say 'מניות 101%' or 'מט"ח 99%'. How can it be more than 100%?
Many rows have no number at all, just 'פחות מ־3 שנים'. I didn't know whether that was good or bad, so I passed over those tracks.
By now I was tired. It was the sixth dark screen full of percentages and the companies kept repeating, so I stopped there.

findings.what: White text on a dark black background, and many small grey letters (the column headings, '3 שנים', 'מההפקדות'). Hard to read even enlarged.
Too many numbers in every row (fee twice, shares, foreign currency, two returns, fund size). It made me anxious and I got tired after six screens.
The page opens with English letters and 'עוקב מדד' instead of telling a cautious person where the safe tracks are.
There is no plain word about risk. I had to work it out myself from 'מניות 0%'.
Many rows show 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a number, with no explanation.
The little circles mean nothing and the two colours look almost the same to me.
Odd figures like 'מניות 101%' make me trust the page less.
I don't know who 'מקור' is. There's no bank or official name I recognise.
